pages.text: Fallen leaves piled in the yard. Red, yellow, brown. Grandpa swept them together.
Nils wanted to jump into a leaf pile. Soft and fluffy! He gathered leaves with both arms too.
The pile reached his knees. "Still small. I'll make it bigger!"
He carried leaves from the far end of the yard. The pile reached his tummy.
Just before jumping, Nils stopped. "A little more. Taller than me!"
Whoosh! Wind swept the yard. Leaves fluttered up into the sky.
The yard was clear again. Only a few leaves remained where the pile had been. Nils hadn't jumped in once.
Grandpa handed him the broom. "How much this time?"
Nils gathered only as high as himself. He hurried before another wind came.
Plunge! Into the leaf pile. Rustle, rustle, soft all around. One leaf settled gently on his nose.
